provenance.author: Jonas Helsen
provenance.method: Computational-basis postselection from the eight-qubit to the seven-qubit cat, together with the signed-Pauli exclusion at seven qubits.

llm.role: Assisted with the lower-bound argument and its exact computational certificate.

notes: Qassim, Pashayan, and Gosset (arXiv:2106.07740, Appendix) proved chi(cat_7) <= chi(cat_8) <= 6. Farrokh Labib established chi(cat_7) >= 6 in September 2026; the challenge records his exact verification in bounds/cat-m7-lower-6.json. Together those results already imply chi(cat_8) = 6. This certificate checks the normalized identity (I x <0|) cat_8 = cat_7 / sqrt(2) and independently reruns the seven-qubit rank-five exclusion using the accompanying signed-Pauli kernels. Postselection maps each stabilizer term to a stabilizer ray or zero. The 1088 surviving rays yield 4831 orbits of unordered triples; the finite-field span test excludes all five-term decompositions. The matching upper bound is recorded in bounds/cat-m8-upper-6.json.
